newsitem.title: INDIA: India Cheminor Drugs inspected by US FDA.
newsitem.headline: India Cheminor Drugs inspected by US FDA.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals maker Cheminor Drugs Ltd said on Friday its ranitidine plant passed an inspection by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) enabling it to enter the U.S. market for some products.
Ranitidine is a bulk chemical used in the manufacture of anti-ulcer medicines.
"The same facility is (also) used for the manufacture of bulk naproxen and bulk naproxen sodium," the firm said.

"Cheminor has earned the distinction of being the first Indian company to be FDA-inspected for these bulk actives. The successful US FDA inspection will enable Cheminor to enter the U.S. market for these products in a big way," it said.

"The company is poised to make the best of the generic wave in that market as naproxen and naproxen sodium are already generic and ranitidine is shortly expected to become generic by July 1997," Cheminor said in a statement.
